0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons in this matchup, with the Sacramento Kings visiting the LA Clippers. The Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 138-109 defeat in Sacramento on April 5, 2026, in their most recent meeting. Sacramento is without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot), Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), and Kobe Sanders, who is day-to-day with a hip issue and a game-time decision, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Kings a 35% chance to win.
